program:
PARAMS = {
    "gbw":    (14e6, 11e6, 25e6),
    "I1":     (80e-6, 30e-6, 120e-6),
    "gmid1":  (20, 14, 24),
    "L1":     (2.0, 0.8, 4.0),
    "gmid3":  (5, 4, 8),
    "L3":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "I7":     (300e-6, 120e-6, 400e-6),
    "gmidn":  (15, 10, 18),
    "Ln":     (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),
    "kz":     (1.0, 0.6, 2.0),
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12); iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    I1 = p["I1"]; Itail = 2*I1; I7 = p["I7"]

    # differential pair, weak/moderate inversion, large area for low 1/f
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.28)
    gm1 = m1.gm
    Cc = gm1/(2*PI*p["gbw"])

    # PMOS mirror load (low gm/Id, long L), M7 same density
    m3a = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1)
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3a.vgs)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=m3.vgs)
    m7 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I7, vds=0.9)
    # NMOS bias mirrors
    mba = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], iref, vds=mba.vgs)
    m5 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], Itail, vds=0.28)
    m8 = lut.size("n", p["gmidn"], p["Ln"], I7, vds=0.9)

    gm7 = m7.gm
    rz = p["kz"] * (1 + cl/Cc) / gm7

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("M5", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m5)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "vinn", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "out1", "vinp", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "out1", "d1", "vdd", "vdd", m4)
    n.dev("M7", "vout", "out1", "vdd", "vdd", m7)
    n.dev("M8", "vout", "ibias", "vss", "vss", m8)
    n.R("RZ", "out1", "cz", rz)
    n.C("CC", "cz", "vout", Cc)

    # predictions
    A1 = gm1/(m1.gds + m4.gds)
    A2 = gm7/(m7.gds + m8.gds)
    gain_db = db(A1*A2)
    ugbw = gm1/(2*PI*Cc)
    C1 = m7.cgg + m4.cdd + m1.cdd
    p2 = gm7/(cl*(1 + C1/Cc) + C1)
    p3 = m3.gm/(2*m3.cgg + m1.cdd)
    wu = 2*PI*ugbw
    wz = 1.0/(Cc*(rz - 1.0/gm7)) if rz > 1.0/gm7 else 1e15
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p2)) - 0.5*math.degrees(math.atan(wu/p3)) \
         + math.degrees(math.atan(wu/wz))
    kT4 = 4*1.380649e-23*300
    r3 = m3.gm/gm1
    vth2 = 2*kT4*0.8/gm1*(1 + r3)
    # empirical 1/f: gate-referred PSD at 1 kHz ~ K/(W*L) [V^2 um^2 / Hz]
    Kn = 1.0e-12; Kp = 0.3e-12
    vf2 = 2*Kn/(m1.W*m1.L) + 2*(r3**2)*Kp/(m3.W*m3.L)
    noise_1k = math.sqrt(vth2 + vf2)
    power = 1.8*(iref + Itail + I7)
    return n, {"gain_db": gain_db, "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm,
               "power": power, "noise_1k": noise_1k}
